fields.label: Effective on
fields.description: The day the bank posted it, which is not always the day it was transacted.

fields.label: Transacted at
fields.description: When it happened, as the bank recorded it. Differs from the effective day by hours normally and by a day at a month boundary.

fields.label: Bank ref
fields.description: The bank's own transaction number. Two payments of the same amount on the same day are two lines, and this is what keeps them two.

fields.label: Balance after
fields.description: What the bank says the account held after this line. Checked against the walk from the opening balance on import.

fields.label: Matched ledger entry
fields.description: Set by a person confirming a suggestion. The link lives here and never on the entry: the ledger is what AuraOS knows and a statement is the bank's own document.
